messages:
sam_sales: FYI — FintechX POC stuck. They pinned `redwood-model-3b-fp16` but in eu-west-1 it's returning model not found. They also require HSM-backed KMS for keys before signing contract. Can SRE/SE assist?

liam_se: Which exact error? any logs? what's the request id?

maria_cs: Customer saw this in the sandbox earlier today. Request id 6f3a2c. Using the standard sandbox account. They want to keep the pinned model if possible.

jess_infra: I checked — `redwood-model-3b-fp16` was deprecated in eu-west-1 last month due to a kernel regression. There's a quantized variant `redwood-model-3b-quant` still available. Error snippet:
```
ERROR: model not available: code=MODEL_NOT_FOUND region=eu-west-1 model=redwood-model-3b-fp16 request_id=6f3a2c
```
We can rollforward the pin to the quant variant, but there may be a small quality delta.

liam_se: Two asks: 1) KMS/HSM path for EU — can Private or Dedicated support their HSM requirement? 2) If we suggest quant rollforward, need a quick eval on their prompt set.

jess_infra: Private + Dedicated support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and HSM via partner HSMs on prem. Hosted BYOK with HSM is limited in eu-west-1 — will need an enterprise addendum. I'll loop legal/pm.

legal_ava: I'll send the standard security questionnaire and note the HSM caveat. We also need their compliance docs (SOC/ISO).

ops-bot: Routing policy check: fallback available — redwood-model-3b-quant in eu-west-1. Auto-fallback is OFF for pinned requests unless SE/ops enable `allow-rollforward`.

maria_cs: The buyer will accept a rollforward only if we can show <=2% regression on their eval/test prompts.

liam_se: I'll run a quick eval. If quant is ok, we can enable a temporary rollforward for the POC. Also need an updated cost estimate — quant may be cheaper, but KMS integration time is extra.

olivia_finance: If they want a Dedicated trial in eu-west-1, finance can prepare a provisional quote. Ballpark for a 50k tokens/day trial: EUR 7k/month. I'll firm up numbers after liam's eval.

sam_sales: Plan: liam to run eval + post results by EOD, jess to confirm KMS path and timeline, legal to send questionnaire, olivia to draft quote. Flag any blockers. :thumbsup:

liam_se: On it. Will start eval now — @maria_cs please DM the masked prompt set.

maria_cs: Uploading a masked eval set to the shared drive and DMing liam.

jess_infra: Quick note — if they insist on the exact fp16 model, we can offer a Dedicated import/provision of that model into eu-west-1 but it requires security review and provisioning lead time (~3 weeks).

sam_sales: Got it. Keep me posted.
